listing.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure HD Ver. — JoJo's Bizarre Adventure HD Ver. — Recompiled Edition (UNREALWINS)
listing.summary: Internal v1.0 Beta reportedly underwent full-game testing without earlier illegal-instruction crashes. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own JoJo's Bizarre Adventure HD Ver. Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow BUILD_JOJO.bat to build the patched SDK, generate game C++ from your own extracted/default.xex and compile the runtime and launcher.
